sources.notes: Extract statements (as rendered by the search tool; wording may be paraphrased): the TsAGI team elaborated a mathematical model of aerodynamics describing asymmetric flow and asymmetric vortex breakdown at high angle of attack, with dynamic lag and static and dynamic hysteresis in lift, side force and the pitch, yaw and roll moments; the model 'was developed on the base of systematical wind tunnel investigations, flight tests in Su-ADB and Flight Research Institute (LII)' and uses additional differential equations for flow-state parameters; the work covered stall, spin and the effectiveness required of aerodynamic and thrust-vector control. First target for page verification.
